content.title: A ‘Junk’ Stock Rally? Waste Management Is Beating the Market Over the Past Month.
content.summary: Waste Management, a leader in the garbage collection and recycling businesses, has been a hot stock as of late.  Shares of Waste Management rose nearly 10% in November while the broader market was relatively flat.  Competitors Republic Services and Waste Connections also enjoyed solid Novembers, rising more than 4% and 5% respectively last month.
